description: Check whether a site's robots.txt allows or blocks AI crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended). Optionally limit the answer to one bot. Note: only robots.txt is checked; a firewall may still block a bot.

url.description: Domain or URL to check, e.g. example.com

name: check_bot_access
title: Check if an AI bot is blocked by robots.txt
